review_text: The place is awesome —-it’s best for those who love coffee and toys combined. I tried hot Cappuccino and iced Salted Caramel, and both tasted great. It’s a plus to have a very approachable and super-friendly owner who single-handedly prepared all our orders. Btw, every corner of the place is photo-worthy.
